title: The shared map check MAP7 reads only files under mapPaths
why: MAP7 reads every tracked file with a mapped extension in the whole repo, not only mapPaths. With json in banchi's codeExtensions that is 606 files, and map-check stalls for over 5 min on demo-assets/mirror/bundle/chunk-0.json (41 MB).
note:
Nov 6 12:01 CST (coordinator replan: Opus plan and critic, main 7975f6d8, roadmap 01995020): DONE, evidence on main (coordinator's replan check).
Nov 5 09:17 CST (coordinator): fix is MAP7 reads only files under mapPaths, plus a test on a large file outside them. It unblocks a small banchi lane that adds json map lines and restores decision hints on 22 files (91 ids), which banchi-retire-map-py ships without, as a banchi debt. The coordinator starts the lane.
